paper.title: Model-Independent Online Learning for Influence Maximization

settings.name_in_paper: Influence maximization semi-bandit with pairwise influence feedback and linear generalization
unmapped: Actions are seed sets of at most K nodes (canonical m) in a known graph with n nodes, possibly with extra combinatorial constraints; reward is the number of influenced nodes (0 to n) under an unknown diffusion model satisfying a monotonicity assumption
Pairwise influence feedback: for each chosen seed u and every node v the learner observes whether v would be influenced by {u} alone under the round's diffusion realization
Pairwise reachability p*_{u,v} = <theta*_u, x_v> with known target features x_v (one unknown d-dim parameter per source node)
Regret is scaled by rho*alpha where rho is the surrogate approximation factor and alpha the oracle approximation factor
Learner has access to an alpha-approximation oracle for maximizing the surrogate f(S,p)
Learner knows the graph G and feature matrix X
settings.definition_quote: In an influence maximization semi-bandit problem, the agent (marketer) knows both $\cG$ and $\cC$, but does not know the diffusion model $\cD$. ... Under this feedback model, at the end of each round $t$, the agent observes $\mathds{1} \big(\{ u\}, v, \cD(\bw_t)\big)$ for all $u \in \cS_t$ and all $v \in \cV$. ... $R^{\kappa}(T) = T \cdot \spr(\cS^*) - \frac{1}{\kappa} \E [ \sum_{t = 1}^{T} \spr( \cS_{t} ) ]$.

symbols.n_nodes: number of nodes in the graph
symbols.sigma_alg: algorithm parameter sigma > 0 (noise scale / learning rate)

tuning: c >= (1/sigma) sqrt(dn log(1 + nT/(sigma^2 lambda d)) + 2 log(n^2 T)) + sqrt(lambda) max_u ||theta*_u||_2

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: For any $\lambda, \sigma>0$, any feature matrix $X$, any $\alpha$-approximation oracle $\oracle$, and any $c$ satisfying ... if we apply $\dilinucb$ with input $( \oracle, X, c, \lambda, \sigma )$, then its $\rho \alpha$-scaled cumulative regret is upper-bounded as $R^{\rho \alpha}(T) \leq \frac{2c}{\rho \alpha} n^{\frac{3}{2}} \sqrt{\frac{d K T \log ( 1 + \frac{n T}{d \lambda \sigma^2} )}{ \lambda \log (1+\frac{1}{\lambda \sigma^2} )}}+ \frac{1}{\rho}.

results.notes: Paper's K (seed set size) mapped to m; paper's n (nodes) declared n_nodes; alpha (oracle factor) mapped to alpha_apx. Regret is rho*alpha-scaled regret, recorded as alpha_regret. c depends on T and max ||theta*_u||.

tuning: c >= (1/sigma) sqrt(dn log(1 + nT/(sigma^2 lambda d)) + 2 log(n^2 T)) + sqrt(lambda) max_u ||theta*_u||_2 with d = n

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: For the tabular case $X=I$, we obtain a tighter bound $R^{\rho \alpha}(T) \leq \frac{2c}{\rho \alpha} n^{\frac{3}{2}} \sqrt{\frac{ K T \log ( 1 + \frac{T}{\lambda \sigma^2} )}{ \lambda \log (1+\frac{1}{\lambda \sigma^2} )}}+ \frac{1}{\rho} .

tuning: c chosen so Inequality (ineq:c) is tight

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: Notice that if we choose $\lambda=\sigma=1$, and choose $c$ s.t. Inequality~\ref{ineq:c} is tight, then our regret bound is $\tilde{O}(n^2 d \sqrt{KT}/(\alpha \rho))$ for general feature matrix $X$
